claims.text: All 26 fixed plan indices have at most one native attempt; censored, failed, unsupported and interrupted cells remain in the denominator. This is the Koblitz 26-cell block of a separately planned 78-cell three-family n23 arity portfolio.
A completed enumeration cell retains counted visited transitions under its m-specific bounded finite-domain outcome; a budget stop or timeout does not certify no decomposition.
An ECDLP scalar label is promoted only after native independent recovery and generator-target group replay.
Each attempted shard retains native verify, report and strict export statuses, a restricted archive and fresh S3 archive and pointer readback receipts; failures remain counted.

positive.not_applicable_reason: Any positive PDP witness or independently recovered ECDLP scalar requires native mathematical replay; this fixed-population pilot makes no detector-sensitivity claim.

stopping_rules.rule: All 26 plan indices0..25, at most one native attempt each; retain every outcome without replacement.

Each generate has 30s inner and 90s outer cap; finite finalization and S3 stage caps. Stop on failed custody and resume finalization only; require 8GiB XFS free before new attempt. Overall campaign 6h ceiling.
